desc: Putting on a Relic (MaskBeat, scripts/ui/mask_beat.gd): build-up, the Relic rising to the face, a cut to black and silence, flashes of the fallen Hunter with a whisper, the snap back with an impact and a ripple of light, a pose, the name and title, and a sting. Times in seconds. 'full' is the first Mask (and every first time); 'short' is a later Mask on the farm. About 1.8x its first cut (owner 11-11: too fast to read). MaskBeat holds the whisper and the name for at least its reading time (2.5 s, or 0.06 s per character), stretching memory_s and reveal_s if a line needs it. A click moves on a beat; after the first one, holding skips.
times_doc: build_s: the world quiets, the camera eases in, swell and heartbeat. rise_s: the Relic lifts to the face in slow motion while a ghostly porcelain face flickers over yours. black_s: the hard silence after contact. memory_s: one entry per memory frame of the fallen Hunter (their painted art). reveal_s: the snap back to the end (pose, name and title, sting). push_in: how far the camera eases in (0..1 of the way to the face).

whispers.gunslinger: Another job. Another mark on the tally.
whispers.juggernaut: The blade is hungry. Feed it, or it feeds on you.
whispers.archer: Every mask I sewed, I will cut loose.
whispers.bulwark: Hold on. The shore is close.
whispers.mage: One day I give the storm back.
whispers.rimewright: Skate. Don't look down at the ice.
whispers.ostra: Go on, laugh. I'll keep it.
whispers.thief: I only meant to take a look.
whispers.gil: Ooh, what does this one do?

sting_doc: Each Hunter's sting is the same rising motif in their own key (semitones from A3).
